title: Marcos spends 69th birthday meeting world leaders at BRICS Summit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. spent his 69th birthday on Sunday at work, meeting world leaders and promoting Philippine economic and infrastructure interests as he attended the 18th BRICS Summit in India.
